page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-48-lssd is a compute-optimized instance configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 180.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration does not include GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The instance features integrated local storage consisting of 8 NVMe SSDs, delivering a total capacity of 3221 GB. The inclusion of high-speed local NVMe storage directly attached to the instance provides low-latency data access, making it distinct from standard network-attached storage configurations. This setup is designed to handle high-throughput local I/O operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-standard-48-lssd offers a high density of dedicated compute resources and local NVMe storage, balancing high-throughput local I/O with substantial processing power. This hardware profile is suited for workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space, database hosting, data-intensive processing, and general-purpose compute tasks that demand low-latency storage access.
